'''2017 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Matt Scott DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Scott]] at [[2017 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

* '''Event:''' [[2017 Texas Mini Worlds]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
